card.essence: Phosphorus suits tall, slender, rapidly-growing persons of sanguine temperament with delicate features, fair skin, and oversensitive nerves. It addresses states of nervous exhaustion, haemorrhagic diathesis (even small wounds bleed profusely), and destructive metabolism leading to fatty degeneration. Burning sensations pervade—especially in chest, spine, palms—alongside intense weakness, trembling, and a characteristic empty, gone sensation in head, chest, and abdomen.
card.sides: Right-sided (especially right lower lung); left-sided aggravation when lying
card.thermal: Ambithermal (head and stomach > cold; body and chest < cold, > warmth)

keynotes.text: Tall, slender, rapidly-growing persons; delicate eyelashes, fair/red hair, sanguine temperament
Haemorrhagic diathesis: small wounds bleed profusely; vicarious menses from nose/stomach/anus
Burning sensations everywhere—spine (heat running up back), palms, chest, stomach
Weak, empty, all-gone sensation in head, chest, stomach, entire abdomen
Oversensitiveness to external impressions: light, sound, odours, touch, thunder storms
Craves cold food/drinks/ice cream (> gastric pains), but vomits water once warm in stomach
Restless, fidgety all over; cannot sit or stand still a moment
Cough < twilight to midnight, going warm→cold air, lying left side; > lying right side
Phosphorus removes bad effects of iodine and excessive salt

modalities_worse.text: Lying on left or painful side
Mental or physical exertion; talking, laughing, reading
After loss of vital fluids; puberty; sexual excesses

modalities_better.text: Cold food, cold water, ice (until warm in stomach)
Cold applications to face and head

mentals: Anxious, fearful—fears being alone, dark, twilight, thunderstorms, death, something will happen
Restless, fidgety all over; cannot sit or stand still
Apathetic, indifferent to friends/family; answers slowly, unwilling to talk
Great lowness of spirits; weary of life, gloomy forebodings
Clairvoyant state; excitable to ecstasy; wild thoughts and imaginations
Over-sensitive to impressions; easily vexed; startles easily
Brain-fag from mental effort; loss of memory; ideas come slowly
Fear/anxiety begins at pit of stomach
Delirium: low muttering, mania à potu; violent maniacal attacks during sleep
physicals: Tall, slender persons who grow too rapidly; narrow-chested; phthisical habit
Dandruff, hair falls out in bunches; bald spots
Eyes: hollow, blue rings; puffy oedematous lids (all around eyes); green halo around candlelight
Nose: fan-like motion of alae; epistaxis (instead of menses); chronic bloody catarrh
Constipation: stools slender, long, dry, tough, hard (like a dog's); great straining
Diarrhoea: profuse, pouring as from hydrant; watery with sago-like particles; painless; involuntary; anus feels open
Larynx painful; cannot talk; hoarseness worse evenings; aphonia; clergyman's sore throat
Pneumonia: especially right lower lobe; oppression worse lying left side; rusty/bloody expectoration
Regurgitation of food in mouthfuls; vomiting as soon as water warms in stomach
Ravenous hunger soon after eating; must eat often or faints; hungry at night
Burning in oesophagus, stomach, chest; tightness across chest
Violent palpitation with anxiety, lying left side; heart dilated (especially right)
Necrosis of lower jaw (or other bones)
Fatty degeneration: liver, heart, kidneys, blood vessels
clinical: Pneumonia (especially right lower lobe) with oppression, rusty sputa, circumscribed red cheek
Tuberculosis in tall, rapidly-growing young people (use high potency, infrequently)
Haemoptysis; vicarious menstruation via epistaxis or haematemesis
Chronic bronchitis with bloody expectoration; nervous cough provoked by strangers or strong odours
Fatty degeneration of liver (acute hepatitis, yellow atrophy); pancreatic disease
Acute/chronic nephritis with haematuria; albuminuria (periodical or with retinitis)
Post-operative vomiting; vomiting in pregnancy (cannot drink water, sight of it causes vomiting)
Vertigo of the aged (especially after rising)
Chlorosis; pernicious anaemia; green sickness in rapidly-growing girls
Necrosis of lower jaw or tibia; caries of bones
Glaucoma; retinal degeneration; thrombosis of retinal vessels; optic atrophy
Paralysis: post-diphtheritic; ascending sensory/motor from fingers/toes; locomotor ataxia
Brain-fag; mental exhaustion from overwork; cerebral softening
Tertiary syphilis with skin lesions and nervous debility

differentials.note: Both burn intensely and have anxiety/restlessness. Ars. chilly, wants heat (except head); restless midnight–3am. Phos. ambithermal; restless evening, before midnight; craves cold drinks.
Both have chest symptoms. Bry. < motion, wants absolute rest; < warm room; cough < entering warm room. Phos. cough < going warm→cold; < lying left; > cold drinks initially.
Both have burning sensations. Sulph. hot patient, wants cool; offensive discharges; feet burn at night. Phos. ambithermal; haemorrhagic; tall, slender; dandruff in clouds.
Both have left-sided chest symptoms; haemorrhagic tendency. Lach. < after sleep, cannot bear tight clothing. Phos. > after sleep; clothing not prominent; craves cold drinks.
Incompatible—must not be used before or after Phos. Caust. right-sided paralysis, hoarseness, urinary incontinence < coughing.
Both have right-sided pneumonia with circumscribed red cheek. Sang. periodic sick headaches; menopausal flushes; < motion. Phos. broader haemorrhagic picture; craves cold food.
Its vegetable analogue per Allen. Both have nasal symptoms; watery discharges. Cepa more acute coryza with laryngeal symptoms; onion-like tearing sensation.

cautions: Do not give too low or too frequently in tuberculosis—may hasten destructive degeneration of tubercular masses
Incompatible with Causticum: must not be used before or after
In advanced paralytic states with complete apathy, ensure remedy picture still matches (may need follow-up remedies)
Haemorrhagic diathesis: bleeding from slight wounds can be dangerous; monitor surgical/dental procedures
In fatty degeneration of organs, ensure regular follow-up for serious pathology (liver, heart, kidneys)
